description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to exceptional patient care. If you are a Registered Nurse with a passion for leadership and a desire to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the highest standards of clinical care for our residents. Your responsibilities will include staff supervision, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and fostering a positive and supportive environment for both staff and residents. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to contribute to a team dedicated to improving the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Proven leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

We are looking for a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background and a commitment to fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This full-time position offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact.

Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to supervise and mentor nursing staff
